name: Zen Jinrui Alpa-ka Sengen!
source:
A story which takes place in a world where all humans have transformed into alpacas.
"Are you confident that you are not an alpaca?"

[Translated from [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=116349]Melonbooks[/url]]
